capabilities: Create a datasource from a file's frontmatter metadata
Define a schema for the datasource using JSON Schema
Customize the form UI with JSON Forms
Render the form in read mode via a data-entry codeblock
Save form input back to the file's metadata
extras: Despite being in the community store, no version has been released yet due to a big refactor; the README warns the UI looks janky and lists a major bug when editing a schema for an already-open note.
motivation: The author describes it as a passion project built to fit their own use case, generalized enough for others.
problem: Obsidian only offers raw frontmatter editing, so entering structured metadata into notes is manual and error-prone.
summary: Form plugin that renders editable forms over frontmatter datasources using JSON Schema, saving entered data back to file metadata.
